properties.name: Edge Router
properties.description: Terminates TLS and routes external traffic to internal services.
properties.value: The single entry point for all external API traffic.

properties.name: Legacy Router
properties.description: Predecessor to the edge router, kept running for one remaining internal client.
properties.value: Nothing — candidate for retirement once the last client migrates.

properties.name: Dunning Service
properties.description: Schedules and sends payment-reminder notifications.
properties.value: Runs the retry schedule for failed payments.

properties.name: Invoice Agent
properties.description: Answers customer questions about their invoices.
properties.value: Deflects a large share of billing support tickets.

properties.name: ETL Orchestrator
properties.description: Schedules and monitors the nightly warehouse load jobs.
properties.value: The one place that knows the full dependency order of the data pipeline.

properties.name: Feature Store
properties.description: Serves precomputed features to the ranking and recommendation models.
properties.value: Low-latency feature lookups backed by Redis with a Postgres system of record.

properties.name: Warehouse Sync
properties.description: Keeps the analytics warehouse in sync with production tables.
properties.value: dbt models plus a Snowflake loader most dashboards depend on.

properties.name: Experiment Service
properties.description: Assigns users to experiment arms and records outcomes.
properties.value: System of record for every running A/B test.

properties.value: Adds per-experiment routing rules on top of the shared model gateway.

properties.name: Onboarding Agent
properties.description: Walks new users through initial account setup.
properties.value: Reduced drop-off during the first-run experience.

properties.name: Support Agent
properties.description: Copied from the mobile team's in-app assistant to answer web app questions.
properties.value: Same assistant as mobile's, retargeted at the web app FAQ.

properties.name: Agent Benchmarks
properties.description: Tracks agent quality metrics release over release.
properties.value: The dashboard the eval harness's results feed into.

properties.name: Eval Harness
properties.description: Runs regression evals against every agent before a release.
properties.value: Catches quality regressions before they reach production.

properties.name: Prompt Lab
properties.description: Internal playground for iterating on prompts across providers.
properties.value: Side-by-side comparison UI for Anthropic and OpenAI responses.

properties.name: Support Agent
properties.description: In-app assistant that answers common mobile app questions.
properties.value: First point of contact before a ticket reaches a human agent.

properties.name: Agent Gateway
properties.description: Routes model calls through Portkey with per-team rate limits and request logging.
properties.value: Central place every other team's agent traffic passes through before it reaches a model provider.

properties.name: Docs Bot
properties.description: Answers engineering questions by searching internal documentation.
properties.value: Cuts down on repeated questions in the platform support channel.

properties.name: Internal CLI
properties.description: Command-line tool that wraps common platform operations.
properties.value: Reduces a dozen manual steps to one command for common tasks.

properties.name: Query Planner
properties.description: Rewrites and dispatches search queries across shards.
properties.value: The routing layer every search request goes through before hitting Elasticsearch.

properties.name: Relevance Agent
properties.description: Uses an LLM to re-rank search results for ambiguous queries.
properties.value: Handles the long tail of queries the classic ranking model scores poorly.

properties.name: Access Review Bot
properties.description: Reminds team leads to review who still has access to sensitive systems.
properties.value: Turns a manual quarterly audit into an automated nudge.

properties.name: Compliance Agent
properties.description: Answers employee questions about internal policy.
properties.value: Deflects routine policy questions from the security team's inbox.

properties.name: Secret Scanner
properties.description: Scans commits for accidentally committed credentials.
properties.value: Runs as a required CI check on every repository.

properties.name: Incident Copilot
properties.description: Summarises alerts and suggests a first response during an incident.
properties.value: Cuts the time to first meaningful action during an on-call page.

properties.name: Runbook Agent
properties.description: Walks an on-call engineer through a known runbook step by step.
properties.value: Encodes tribal knowledge that used to live only in a wiki.
